# utilities.consolidation.haversine_distance

### utilities.consolidation.haversine_distance(lat1: [float](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float), lon1: [float](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float), lat2: [float](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float), lon2: [float](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float)) → [float](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float)

Calculate the great circle distance between two points in kilometers.

* **Parameters:**
  * **lat1** – First point in decimal degrees
  * **lon1** – First point in decimal degrees
  * **lat2** – Second point in decimal degrees
  * **lon2** – Second point in decimal degrees
* **Returns:**
  Distance in kilometers
